data.title: 木更 · 契约者的深夜
data.description: 昏暗狭窄的公寓卧室里，唯有窗外霓虹的残光斜斜照进。白衬衫纽扣完全敞开的木更跨坐在床边，恶魔的契约之痕在雪白胸口幽幽发亮，她深深吻上你的唇瓣——「把你的记忆和体温全部交给我……修，只要能永远留在我身边，无论什么代价我都甘之如饴。」
data.lighting: faint city neon through the window, a subdued glow from the contract mark
data.mood: 恶魔契约与炽热独占欲
data.promptProse: Adult Kisara sits at the bed edge in her open white shirt, leaning toward the offscreen viewer for a kiss. The faint contract mark on her chest glows against the last neon light entering the room.
data.animaCaption: She leans from the bed edge toward the offscreen viewer for a kiss.
